n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (You find her holding a small carved token, grief plain on her face — gone the instant she notices you.)

n2.speaker: thora
n2.text: It's nothing. Are you hungry? Let me make something.

choices.text: "You don't have to hide it from me."
(Let her change the subject. Accept the food.)

n3_press.speaker: thora
n3_press.text: ...It was my clan's. One of the few things that crossed with me.
